other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.
Applicant must represent or own any MSE unit.
MSEs that have availed loans from any Scheduled Commercial Banks, Non‑Banking Finance Companies (NBFCs), or State Finance Corporations are eligible.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 80% or ₹1,00,000 (whichever is lower) of Performance Bank Guarantee charges incurred in a financial year.
